name: One-Stroke Atelier
description: Forge the badge shown on the target plate using a single continuous stroke across the directional command bars and motif jig. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Programs in an isolated agent sandbox may process screenshots and issue mouse and keyboard actions through the provided gateway. Do not access the task environment through Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network or source inspection, DOM or page-state inspection, the task terminal or shell, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.
natural_language: Press and hold the brass START seal. Without releasing, cross the target TOOL, COLOUR, WIDTH, and STAMP bars in each marked direction as the bench reconfigures, trace the six-point badge motif, and release on FINISH. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Programs in an isolated agent sandbox may process screenshots and issue mouse and keyboard actions through the provided gateway. Do not access the task environment through Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network or source inspection, DOM or page-state inspection, the task terminal or shell, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.
